title: JAX Open-Source Release
summary: JAX's official repository citation metadata states that 2018 corresponds to the project's open-source release, and Google Research's 2018 retrospective says Google released JAX that year as an accelerator-backed NumPy system supporting automatic differentiation and using XLA infrastructure.
significance: A first-party, year-precision public-release milestone for JAX that can be recorded without inventing a day or month or treating the release year as an invention or development-start date.

verification.note: The official JAX repository's citation section explicitly says that the year 2018 corresponds to the project's open-source release. Google Research's January 15, 2019 retrospective independently states that Google released JAX in 2018 and describes it as an accelerator-backed variant of NumPy supporting automatic differentiation and leveraging XLA infrastructure. This candidate is limited to a year-precision open-source-release milestone and does not infer an exact release day or month, invention/system-birth date, development-start date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or unsupported relationship.

sources.title: Looking Back at Google’s Research Efforts in 2018
